text:
priya (CS): Heads up — Kinetix renewal needs signoff by end of week. Procurement insists on PO instead of CC. Contract shows Net30, customer is pushing Net45. We offered 9mo at 10% off, finance wants to keep 7% — need quick alignment. Also onboarding team says they can't start until payment clears — potential churn risk. Anyone available to jump in?

liam (AE): On it. I was on call earlier — they prefer PO for internal audit. Can accept 9mo but they want invoice to their US entity. I'll confirm PO # and vendor code today.

sofia (Legal): Send me the redline request. If we change payment terms to Net45 we need signoff from legal for revenue recognition. Also if invoice entity changes, need SOW amendment. Example amendment snippet:
```
Amendment: Invoice entity updated to Kinetix US (EIN: 12-3456789). Payment terms updated to Net45 upon mutual signature. All other terms unchanged.
```

ben (Onboarding): If payment isn't cleared by 2026-05-10, we can't guarantee kickoff on 2026-05-15. We can provision limited (read-only) access earlier, but full enablement requires payment.

priya (CS): Can we do DocuSign with PO attachment? I can push for the PO today if AE gets vendor code. @liam (AE) pinged.

liam (AE): Vendor code is VEND-9923 per their procurement email. They said PO will be raised and emailed to billing@redwood.com. I'll ask for CC fallback if PO delayed.

finance-bot: Invoice created: INV-2026-7789 (Net30). Please confirm if Net45 approved, else auto-process Net30.

sofia (Legal): If PO is attached, legal ok with SOW amendment via addendum PDF + signature. Need on record: 'invoice entity: Kinetix US, tax id: 12-3456789'.

docuSign-bot: DocuSign envelope 0a1b2c: 'Kinetix Renewal - 9mo' created by priya (CS). Pending signatures: Kinetix PM, liam (AE), priya (CS). Link: https://docusign.example/0a1b2c

priya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll upload PO when it arrives. @ben (Onboarding) please set tentative kickoff for 2026-05-20 if payment delays.

ben (Onboarding): Set tentative 2026-05-20 slot. Will hold off final invites until payment/PO attached.

liam (AE): PO received from procurement — PO# 987654. Uploading now.

docuSign-bot: PO attachment uploaded to envelope 0a1b2c by liam (AE).

sofia (Legal): I counter-signed clause amendment. priya, can you route signed addendum to renewals@ and cc finance?

priya (CS): Done. Sent signed addendum + PO to renewals@ and billing@. Finance: please confirm invoice window and mark for Net45 per customer's ask.

finance-bot: Invoice updated to Net45 per approval. New invoice INV-2026-7789-01. Accounting notes: recognize per amended SOW. :white_check_mark:

liam (AE): :tada: All set — Kinetix signed via DocuSign. Onboarding scheduled 2026-05-20 tentative, confirmed once payment posts.

priya (CS): Thank you everyone. I'll follow up with a short NPS/questionnaire during onboarding. Closing thread.
file_note: Renewal thread: PO-vs-CC, Net30->Net45 request, addendum/SOW amendment, DocuSign envelope, onboarding scheduling risk. Single Slack thread captured in chronological messages.
